source.section: Form 511 lines 1-14 and 18 (PDF pages 42-43); select line instructions (PDF pages 9-10); standard deduction line 10 (PDF page 10); exemptions line 11 and the Regular exemption terms (PDF pages 8 and 10); Tax Table (PDF pages 27-38)

worked: Federal AGI = wages (you) 6,000.00 = 6,000.00. Federal taxable income = 6,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = -9,750.00, floored at 0.00 (federal senior deduction ignored; federal figures are given, not tested; Oklahoma starts from federal AGI). Form 511: line 1 federal AGI 6,000.00; line 2 subtractions 0.00; line 3 = 6,000.00 - 0.00 = 6,000.00; line 4 out-of-state income 0.00; line 5 6,000.00; line 6 additions 0.00; line 7 Oklahoma AGI 6,000.00; line 8 adjustments 0.00; line 9 6,000.00; line 10 standard deduction (single) 6,350.00; line 11 exemptions: 1 Regular + 0 Special = 1 x 1,000.00 = 1,000.00 (no one is 65 or older, 0 Special); line 12 = 6,350.00 + 1,000.00 = 7,350.00; line 13 taxable income = 6,000.00 - 7,350.00 = -1,350.00, floored at 0.00 in expected; line 14 tax 0.00. Line 13 is under 100,000, so the form reads the tax table: row 0-50, column 'Single or married filing separate', PDF page 27, gives 0; expected keeps the schedule figure. Lines 15-17 credits 0.00; line 18 income tax 0.00. The form's line 9 minus line 12 is below zero; taxable income is floored at 0.00.
